1: # Developer Notes - DataSync API
2: # These are internal notes from the dev team - NOT for external publication
3: # Last updated by multiple contributors
4: 
5: == AUTH STUFF ==
6: We use JWT tokens now. Changed from API keys last sprint (v2.1).
7: Token expires in 1 hour. Refresh tokens last 7 days.
8: Header format: Authorization: Bearer <token>
9: Login endpoint: POST /auth/login - takes email+password, returns tokens
10: Refresh: POST /auth/refresh - takes refresh_token in body
11: 
12: BUG: Sometimes 401 returns instead of 403 when token valid but perms wrong
13: TODO: Fix in next sprint (JIRA-4521)
14: 
15: == DATA ENDPOINTS ==
16: 
17: /datasets - GET list all datasets for user
18: params: page (default 1), limit (default 20, max 100), status (active|archived|all)
19: returns array of dataset objects
20: 
21: /datasets/{id} - GET single dataset
22: 404 if not found or not owned by user
23: 
24: /datasets - POST create new dataset
25: body: { name: string (required, 3-100 chars), description: string (optional), tags: array }
26: returns created dataset with id
27: 
28: /datasets/{id} - PUT update dataset
29: same body as POST but all fields optional
30: returns updated dataset
31: 
32: /datasets/{id} - DELETE soft delete (sets archived flag)
33: returns 204 no content
34: 
35: /datasets/{id}/records - GET records in dataset
36: pagination same as /datasets list
37: params: sort (field name), order (asc|desc), filter (JSON encoded query)
38: 
39: /datasets/{id}/records - POST add record(s)
40: body can be single object or array for bulk insert
41: max 1000 records per request
42: 
43: /datasets/{id}/records/{record_id} - PATCH update single record
44: body: partial record object
45: 
46: /datasets/{id}/sync - POST trigger sync with external source
47: body: { source_id: string, mode: "full"|"incremental" }
48: returns job_id for async tracking
49: 
50: /jobs/{job_id} - GET check job status
51: response: { status: "pending"|"running"|"completed"|"failed", progress: 0-100, error: string|null }
52: 
53: == ERROR CODES ==
54: 
55: 400 - bad request (validation failed) - body has "errors" array with field-specific messages
56: 401 - not authenticated
57: 403 - forbidden (authenticated but not authorized)
58: 404 - not found
59: 409 - conflict (e.g., duplicate name)
60: 422 - unprocessable entity (business rule violation)
61: 429 - rate limited (100 req/min for free tier, 1000 for pro)
62: 500 - server error (we log these, include request_id in response for support)
63: 
64: == RESPONSE FORMAT ==
65: 
66: All responses wrapped:
67: {
68:   "success": true|false,
69:   "data": <payload>|null,
70:   "error": null|{ "code": "ERR_CODE", "message": "Human readable", "details": {} },
71:   "meta": { "request_id": "uuid", "timestamp": "ISO8601" }
72: }
73: 
74: == WEBHOOKS (v2.2 feature) ==
75: 
76: POST /webhooks - create webhook
77: body: { url: string, events: ["dataset.created", "dataset.updated", "sync.completed", "sync.failed"], secret: string (optional, for HMAC signing) }
78: 
79: GET /webhooks - list webhooks
80: DELETE /webhooks/{id} - remove webhook
81: 
82: Webhook payload:
83: {
84:   "event": "event.type",
85:   "timestamp": "ISO8601",
86:   "data": { <event specific> }
87: }
88: 
89: If secret provided, we send X-Webhook-Signature header with HMAC-SHA256 of body
90: 
91: == RATE LIMITS ==
92: 
93: Free tier: 100 requests/minute, 10000/day
94: Pro tier: 1000 requests/minute, unlimited daily
95: Enterprise: custom
96: 
97: Headers returned:
98: X-RateLimit-Limit: <max>
99: X-RateLimit-Remaining: <remaining>
100: X-RateLimit-Reset: <unix timestamp>
101: 
102: == SDK notes ==
103: 
104: Python SDK wraps all this, handles auth refresh automatically
105: JS SDK in beta - dont document yet
106: Java SDK abandoned - dont mention
107: 
108: == CHANGELOG snippets ==
109: 
110: v2.2.0 (2024-12-15)
111: - Added webhooks
112: - Fixed: sync jobs sometimes stuck in "running"
113: - Improved: bulk insert now 3x faster
114: 
115: v2.1.0 (2024-11-01)
116: - BREAKING: Switched to JWT auth (API keys deprecated, removed in v3)
117: - Added incremental sync mode
118: - Fixed: rate limit headers missing on 429 responses
119: 
120: v2.0.0 (2024-09-15)
121: - Complete rewrite
122: - New endpoint structure
123: - Added job queue for async operations
124: 
125: == MISC ==
126: 
127: Base URL: https://api.datasync.io/v2
128: Sandbox: https://sandbox.api.datasync.io/v2 (resets daily, fake data ok)
129: 
130: Content-Type must be application/json for all POST/PUT/PATCH
131: 
132: CORS enabled for *.datasync.io domains, customers can request whitelist
133: 
134: OpenAPI spec is auto-generated but has bugs - dont use directly, needs manual cleanup

(End of file - total 134 lines)

2: 
3: > Based off https://palantir.quip.com/pzRwAVr1bpzf
4: 
5: Pro-tip: look through the github diff between the previous release to see what's changed. The commit titles should give an outline of what's happened.
6: 
7: ### Upgrade Steps
8: 
9: - List out, as concretely as possible, any steps users have to take when they upgrade beyond just dumping the dependency.
10: - Write pseudocode that highlights what code should change and how.
11: - Call out if users are recommended to upgrade because of known problems with older releases.
12: - Preferably, there's nothing here.
13: 
14: ### Breaking Changes
15: 
16: - A complete list of breaking changes (preferably there are none, unless this is a major version).
17: 
18: ### New Features
19: 
20: - Describe the new feature and when/why to use it. Add some pictures! Call out any caveats/warnings? Is it a beta feature?
21: 
22: ### Bug Fixes
23: 
24: - Call out any existing feature/functionality that now works as intended or expected.
25: 
26: ### Improvements
27: 
28: - Improvements/enhancements to a workflow, performance, logging, error messaging, or user experience
29:

1: # Developer Notes - DataSync API
2: # These are internal notes from the dev team - NOT for external publication
3: # Last updated by multiple contributors
4: 
5: == AUTH STUFF ==
6: We use JWT tokens now. Changed from API keys last sprint (v2.1).
7: Token expires in 1 hour. Refresh tokens last 7 days.
8: Header format: Authorization: Bearer <token>
9: Login endpoint: POST /auth/login - takes email+password, returns tokens
10: Refresh: POST /auth/refresh - takes refresh_token in body
11: 
12: BUG: Sometimes 401 returns instead of 403 when token valid but perms wrong
13: TODO: Fix in next sprint (JIRA-4521)
14: 
15: == DATA ENDPOINTS ==
16: 
17: /datasets - GET list all datasets for user
18: params: page (default 1), limit (default 20, max 100), status (active|archived|all)
19: returns array of dataset objects
20: 
21: /datasets/{id} - GET single dataset
22: 404 if not found or not owned by user
23: 
24: /datasets - POST create new dataset
25: body: { name: string (required, 3-100 chars), description: string (optional), tags: array }
26: returns created dataset with id
27: 
28: /datasets/{id} - PUT update dataset
29: same body as POST but all fields optional
30: returns updated dataset
31: 
32: /datasets/{id} - DELETE soft delete (sets archived flag)
33: returns 204 no content
34: 
35: /datasets/{id}/records - GET records in dataset
36: pagination same as /datasets list
37: params: sort (field name), order (asc|desc), filter (JSON encoded query)
38: 
39: /datasets/{id}/records - POST add record(s)
40: body can be single object or array for bulk insert
41: max 1000 records per request
42: 
43: /datasets/{id}/records/{record_id} - PATCH update single record
44: body: partial record object
45: 
46: /datasets/{id}/sync - POST trigger sync with external source
47: body: { source_id: string, mode: "full"|"incremental" }
48: returns job_id for async tracking
49: 
50: /jobs/{job_id} - GET check job status
51: response: { status: "pending"|"running"|"completed"|"failed", progress: 0-100, error: string|null }
52: 
53: == ERROR CODES ==
54: 
55: 400 - bad request (validation failed) - body has "errors" array with field-specific messages
56: 401 - not authenticated
57: 403 - forbidden (authenticated but not authorized)
58: 404 - not found
59: 409 - conflict (e.g., duplicate name)
60: 422 - unprocessable entity (business rule violation)
61: 429 - rate limited (100 req/min for free tier, 1000 for pro)
62: 500 - server error (we log these, include request_id in response for support)
63: 
64: == RESPONSE FORMAT ==
65: 
66: All responses wrapped:
67: {
68:   "success": true|false,
69:   "data": <payload>|null,
70:   "error": null|{ "code": "ERR_CODE", "message": "Human readable", "details": {} },
71:   "meta": { "request_id": "uuid", "timestamp": "ISO8601" }
72: }
73: 
74: == WEBHOOKS (v2.2 feature) ==
75: 
76: POST /webhooks - create webhook
77: body: { url: string, events: ["dataset.created", "dataset.updated", "sync.completed", "sync.failed"], secret: string (optional, for HMAC signing) }
78: 
79: GET /webhooks - list webhooks
80: DELETE /webhooks/{id} - remove webhook
81: 
82: Webhook payload:
83: {
84:   "event": "event.type",
85:   "timestamp": "ISO8601",
86:   "data": { <event specific> }
87: }
88: 
89: If secret provided, we send X-Webhook-Signature header with HMAC-SHA256 of body
90: 
91: == RATE LIMITS ==
92: 
93: Free tier: 100 requests/minute, 10000/day
94: Pro tier: 1000 requests/minute, unlimited daily
95: Enterprise: custom
96: 
97: Headers returned:
98: X-RateLimit-Limit: <max>
99: X-RateLimit-Remaining: <remaining>
100: X-RateLimit-Reset: <unix timestamp>
101: 
102: == SDK notes ==
103: 
104: Python SDK wraps all this, handles auth refresh automatically
105: JS SDK in beta - dont document yet
106: Java SDK abandoned - dont mention
107: 
108: == CHANGELOG snippets ==
109: 
110: v2.2.0 (2024-12-15)
111: - Added webhooks
112: - Fixed: sync jobs sometimes stuck in "running"
113: - Improved: bulk insert now 3x faster
114: 
115: v2.1.0 (2024-11-01)
116: - BREAKING: Switched to JWT auth (API keys deprecated, removed in v3)
117: - Added incremental sync mode
118: - Fixed: rate limit headers missing on 429 responses
119: 
120: v2.0.0 (2024-09-15)
121: - Complete rewrite
122: - New endpoint structure
123: - Added job queue for async operations
124: 
125: == MISC ==
126: 
127: Base URL: https://api.datasync.io/v2
128: Sandbox: https://sandbox.api.datasync.io/v2 (resets daily, fake data ok)
129: 
130: Content-Type must be application/json for all POST/PUT/PATCH
131: 
132: CORS enabled for *.datasync.io domains, customers can request whitelist
133: 
134: OpenAPI spec is auto-generated but has bugs - dont use directly, needs manual cleanup

Python token manager:

```python
import time, requests

class DataSyncAuth:
    def __init__(self, email, password, base_url="https://api.datasync.io/v2"):
        self.base_url, self.email, self.password = base_url, email, password
        self.access = self.refresh_tok = None
        self.access_exp = 0

    def token(self):
        if time.time() > self.access_exp - 300:   # refresh 5 min early
            self._refresh_or_login()
        return self.access

    def _refresh_or_login(self):
        if self.refresh_tok:
            r = requests.post(f"{self.base_url}/auth/refresh",
                              json={"refresh_token": self.refresh_tok})
            if r.status_code == 200:
                self._store(r.json()["data"]); return
            # 400 invalid / 401 expired -> fall through to full login
        r = requests.post(f"{self.base_url}/auth/login",
                          json={"email": self.email, "password": self.password})
        r.raise_for_status()
        self._store(r.json()["data"])

    def _store(self, data):
        self.access, self.refresh_tok = data["access_token"], data["refresh_token"]
        self.access_exp = time.time() + 3600   # access tokens last 1 hour
```

# DataSync API — Migration Guide: v2.0 → v2.2

Applies to: DataSync API v2.2.x. Written for teams migrating from v2.0.x (also covers teams still on v2.1.x).

## Contents
- list

## 1. Overview: what changed since v2.0

| Version | Release date | Headline changes | Migration impact |
|---|---|---|---|
| v2.0.0 | 2024-09-15 | Complete rewrite; new endpoint structure; job queue for async operations | — (your baseline) |
| v2.1.0 | 2024-11-01 | **JWT authentication (breaking)**; API keys deprecated (removed in v3.0); incremental sync mode; rate-limit headers now included on 429 responses | **High** |
| v2.2.0 | 2024-12-15 | Webhooks; sync-job reliability fix; bulk inserts up to 3× faster | Low (additive) |

Because v2.1 introduced the only breaking change, a v2.0 → v2.2 migration is effectively a v2.0 → v2.1 auth migration plus additive v2.2 features.

## 2. Upgrade path at a glance

Steps + checklist-ish:
1. Inventory ...
2. Migrate auth to JWT (Section 3) — required
3. Adopt incremental sync (Section 4) — recommended
4. Add webhook subscriptions (Section 5) — optional
5. Review bulk/rate-limit handling (Section 6) — recommended
6. Validate in sandbox
7. Roll out in waves, monitor, revoke keys

Note sandbox: https://sandbox.api.datasync.io/v2 resets daily with fake data.

## 3. Authentication: API keys → JWT (breaking change from v2.1)

### 3.1 What changed
- v2.0: static API keys ...
- v2.1+: JWT. POST /auth/login returns access_token (1 hour) + refresh_token (7 days). Authorization: Bearer <token>.
- API keys deprecated since v2.1; removed in v3.0. During the entire v2.x deprecation window both methods work.

<content>
1: # Developer Notes - DataSync API
2: # These are internal notes from the dev team - NOT for external publication
3: # Last updated by multiple contributors
4: 
5: == AUTH STUFF ==
6: We use JWT tokens now. Changed from API keys last sprint (v2.1).
7: Token expires in 1 hour. Refresh tokens last 7 days.
8: Header format: Authorization: Bearer <token>
9: Login endpoint: POST /auth/login - takes email+password, returns tokens
10: Refresh: POST /auth/refresh - takes refresh_token in body
11: 
12: BUG: Sometimes 401 returns instead of 403 when token valid but perms wrong
13: TODO: Fix in next sprint (JIRA-4521)
14: 
15: == DATA ENDPOINTS ==
16: 
17: /datasets - GET list all datasets for user
18: params: page (default 1), limit (default 20, max 100), status (active|archived|all)
19: returns array of dataset objects
20: 
21: /datasets/{id} - GET single dataset
22: 404 if not found or not owned by user
23: 
24: /datasets - POST create new dataset
25: body: { name: string (required, 3-100 chars), description: string (optional), tags: array }
26: returns created dataset with id
27: 
28: /datasets/{id} - PUT update dataset
29: same body as POST but all fields optional
30: returns updated dataset
31: 
32: /datasets/{id} - DELETE soft delete (sets archived flag)
33: returns 204 no content
34: 
35: /datasets/{id}/records - GET records in dataset
36: pagination same as /datasets list
37: params: sort (field name), order (asc|desc), filter (JSON encoded query)
38: 
39: /datasets/{id}/records - POST add record(s)
40: body can be single object or array for bulk insert
41: max 1000 records per request
42: 
43: /datasets/{id}/records/{record_id} - PATCH update single record
44: body: partial record object
45: 
46: /datasets/{id}/sync - POST trigger sync with external source
47: body: { source_id: string, mode: "full"|"incremental" }
48: returns job_id for async tracking
49: 
50: /jobs/{job_id} - GET check job status
51: response: { status: "pending"|"running"|"completed"|"failed", progress: 0-100, error: string|null }
52: 
53: == ERROR CODES ==
54: 
55: 400 - bad request (validation failed) - body has "errors" array with field-specific messages
56: 401 - not authenticated
57: 403 - forbidden (authenticated but not authorized)
58: 404 - not found
59: 409 - conflict (e.g., duplicate name)
60: 422 - unprocessable entity (business rule violation)
61: 429 - rate limited (100 req/min for free tier, 1000 for pro)
62: 500 - server error (we log these, include request_id in response for support)
63: 
64: == RESPONSE FORMAT ==
65: 
66: All responses wrapped:
67: {
68:   "success": true|false,
69:   "data": <payload>|null,
70:   "error": null|{ "code": "ERR_CODE", "message": "Human readable", "details": {} },
71:   "meta": { "request_id": "uuid", "timestamp": "ISO8601" }
72: }
73: 
74: == WEBHOOKS (v2.2 feature) ==
75: 
76: POST /webhooks - create webhook
77: body: { url: string, events: ["dataset.created", "dataset.updated", "sync.completed", "sync.failed"], secret: string (optional, for HMAC signing) }
78: 
79: GET /webhooks - list webhooks
80: DELETE /webhooks/{id} - remove webhook
81: 
82: Webhook payload:
83: {
84:   "event": "event.type",
85:   "timestamp": "ISO8601",
86:   "data": { <event specific> }
87: }
88: 
89: If secret provided, we send X-Webhook-Signature header with HMAC-SHA256 of body
90: 
91: == RATE LIMITS ==
92: 
93: Free tier: 100 requests/minute, 10000/day
94: Pro tier: 1000 requests/minute, unlimited daily
95: Enterprise: custom
96: 
97: Headers returned:
98: X-RateLimit-Limit: <max>
99: X-RateLimit-Remaining: <remaining>
100: X-RateLimit-Reset: <unix timestamp>
101: 
102: == SDK notes ==
103: 
104: Python SDK wraps all this, handles auth refresh automatically
105: JS SDK in beta - dont document yet
106: Java SDK abandoned - dont mention
107: 
108: == CHANGELOG snippets ==
109: 
110: v2.2.0 (2024-12-15)
111: - Added webhooks
112: - Fixed: sync jobs sometimes stuck in "running"
113: - Improved: bulk insert now 3x faster
114: 
115: v2.1.0 (2024-11-01)
116: - BREAKING: Switched to JWT auth (API keys deprecated, removed in v3)
117: - Added incremental sync mode
118: - Fixed: rate limit headers missing on 429 responses
119: 
120: v2.0.0 (2024-09-15)
121: - Complete rewrite
122: - New endpoint structure
123: - Added job queue for async operations
124: 
125: == MISC ==
126: 
127: Base URL: https://api.datasync.io/v2
128: Sandbox: https://sandbox.api.datasync.io/v2 (resets daily, fake data ok)
129: 
130: Content-Type must be application/json for all POST/PUT/PATCH
131: 
132: CORS enabled for *.datasync.io domains, customers can request whitelist
133: 
134: OpenAPI spec is auto-generated but has bugs - dont use directly, needs manual cleanup

(End of file - total 134 lines)
</content>", "type": "text"}]

1: # Developer Notes - DataSync API
2: # These are internal notes from the dev team - NOT for external publication
3: # Last updated by multiple contributors
4: 
5: == AUTH STUFF ==
6: We use JWT tokens now. Changed from API keys last sprint (v2.1).
7: Token expires in 1 hour. Refresh tokens last 7 days.
8: Header format: Authorization: Bearer <token>
9: Login endpoint: POST /auth/login - takes email+password, returns tokens
10: Refresh: POST /auth/refresh - takes refresh_token in body
11: 
12: BUG: Sometimes 401 returns instead of 403 when token valid but perms wrong
13: TODO: Fix in next sprint (JIRA-4521)
14: 
15: == DATA ENDPOINTS ==
16: 
17: /datasets - GET list all datasets for user
18: params: page (default 1), limit (default 20, max 100), status (active|archived|all)
19: returns array of dataset objects
20: 
21: /datasets/{id} - GET single dataset
22: 404 if not found or not owned by user
23: 
24: /datasets - POST create new dataset
25: body: { name: string (required, 3-100 chars), description: string (optional), tags: array }
26: returns created dataset with id
27: 
28: /datasets/{id} - PUT update dataset
29: same body as POST but all fields optional
30: returns updated dataset
31: 
32: /datasets/{id} - DELETE soft delete (sets archived flag)
33: returns 204 no content
34: 
35: /datasets/{id}/records - GET records in dataset
36: pagination same as /datasets list
37: params: sort (field name), order (asc|desc), filter (JSON encoded query)
38: 
39: /datasets/{id}/records - POST add record(s)
40: body can be single object or array for bulk insert
41: max 1000 records per request
42: 
43: /datasets/{id}/records/{record_id} - PATCH update single record
44: body: partial record object
45: 
46: /datasets/{id}/sync - POST trigger sync with external source
47: body: { source_id: string, mode: "full"|"incremental" }
48: returns job_id for async tracking
49: 
50: /jobs/{job_id} - GET check job status
51: response: { status: "pending"|"running"|"completed"|"failed", progress: 0-100, error: string|null }
52: 
53: == ERROR CODES ==
54: 
55: 400 - bad request (validation failed) - body has "errors" array with field-specific messages
56: 401 - not authenticated
57: 403 - forbidden (authenticated but not authorized)
58: 404 - not found
59: 409 - conflict (e.g., duplicate name)
60: 422 - unprocessable entity (business rule violation)
61: 429 - rate limited (100 req/min for free tier, 1000 for pro)
62: 500 - server error (we log these, include request_id in response for support)
63: 
64: == RESPONSE FORMAT ==
65: 
66: All responses wrapped:
67: {
68:   "success": true|false,
69:   "data": <payload>|null,
70:   "error": null|{ "code": "ERR_CODE", "message": "Human readable", "details": {} },
71:   "meta": { "request_id": "uuid", "timestamp": "ISO8601" }
72: }
73: 
74: == WEBHOOKS (v2.2 feature) ==
75: 
76: POST /webhooks - create webhook
77: body: { url: string, events: ["dataset.created", "dataset.updated", "sync.completed", "sync.failed"], secret: string (optional, for HMAC signing) }
78: 
79: GET /webhooks - list webhooks
80: DELETE /webhooks/{id} - remove webhook
81: 
82: Webhook payload:
83: {
84:   "event": "event.type",
85:   "timestamp": "ISO8601",
86:   "data": { <event specific> }
87: }
88: 
89: If secret provided, we send X-Webhook-Signature header with HMAC-SHA256 of body
90: 
91: == RATE LIMITS ==
92: 
93: Free tier: 100 requests/minute, 10000/day
94: Pro tier: 1000 requests/minute, unlimited daily
95: Enterprise: custom
96: 
97: Headers returned:
98: X-RateLimit-Limit: <max>
99: X-RateLimit-Remaining: <remaining>
100: X-RateLimit-Reset: <unix timestamp>
101: 
102: == SDK notes ==
103: 
104: Python SDK wraps all this, handles auth refresh automatically
105: JS SDK in beta - dont document yet
106: Java SDK abandoned - dont mention
107: 
108: == CHANGELOG snippets ==
109: 
110: v2.2.0 (2024-12-15)
111: - Added webhooks
112: - Fixed: sync jobs sometimes stuck in "running"
113: - Improved: bulk insert now 3x faster
114: 
115: v2.1.0 (2024-11-01)
116: - BREAKING: Switched to JWT auth (API keys deprecated, removed in v3)
117: - Added incremental sync mode
118: - Fixed: rate limit headers missing on 429 responses
119: 
120: v2.0.0 (2024-09-15)
121: - Complete rewrite
122: - New endpoint structure
123: - Added job queue for async operations
124: 
125: == MISC ==
126: 
127: Base URL: https://api.datasync.io/v2
128: Sandbox: https://sandbox.api.datasync.io/v2 (resets daily, fake data ok)
129: 
130: Content-Type must be application/json for all POST/PUT/PATCH
131: 
132: CORS enabled for *.datasync.io domains, customers can request whitelist
133: 
134: OpenAPI spec is auto-generated but has bugs - dont use directly, needs manual cleanup

(End of file - total 134 lines)

1: # Release Notes Template

3: > Based off https://palantir.quip.com/pzRwAVr1bpzf
4: 
5: Pro-tip: look through the github diff between the previous release to see what's changed. The commit titles should give an outline of what's happened.
6: 
7: ### Upgrade Steps
8: 
9: - List out, as concretely as possible, any steps users have to take when they upgrade beyond just dumping the dependency.
10: - Write pseudocode that highlights what code should change and how.
11: - Call out if users are recommended to upgrade because of known problems with older releases.
12: - Preferably, there's nothing here.
13: 
14: ### Breaking Changes
15: 
16: - A complete list of breaking changes (preferably there are none, unless this is a major version).
17: 
18: ### New Features
19: 
20: - Describe the new feature and when/why to use it. Add some pictures! Call out any caveats/warnings? Is it a beta feature?
21: 
22: ### Bug Fixes
23: 
24: - Call out any existing feature/functionality that now works as intended or expected.
25: 
26: ### Improvements
27: 
28: - Improvements/enhancements to a workflow, performance, logging, error messaging, or user experience
29: 
30: ### Other Changes
31: 
32: - Other miscellaneous changes that don't fit into any of the above categories. Try to leave this empty - ideally, all changes fit into the categories above
33:

1: # Developer Notes - DataSync API
2: # These are internal notes from the dev team - NOT for external publication
3: # Last updated by multiple contributors
4: 
5: == AUTH STUFF ==
6: We use JWT tokens now. Changed from API keys last sprint (v2.1).
7: Token expires in 1 hour. Refresh tokens last 7 days.
8: Header format: Authorization: Bearer <token>
9: Login endpoint: POST /auth/login - takes email+password, returns tokens
10: Refresh: POST /auth/refresh - takes refresh_token in body
11: 
12: BUG: Sometimes 401 returns instead of 403 when token valid but perms wrong
13: TODO: Fix in next sprint (JIRA-4521)
14: 
15: == DATA ENDPOINTS ==
16: 
17: /datasets - GET list all datasets for user
18: params: page (default 1), limit (default 20, max 100), status (active|archived|all)
19: returns array of dataset objects
20: 
21: /datasets/{id} - GET single dataset
22: 404 if not found or not owned by user
23: 
24: /datasets - POST create new dataset
25: body: { name: string (required, 3-100 chars), description: string (optional), tags: array }
26: returns created dataset with id
27: 
28: /datasets/{id} - PUT update dataset
29: same body as POST but all fields optional
30: returns updated dataset
31: 
32: /datasets/{id} - DELETE soft delete (sets archived flag)
33: returns 204 no content
34: 
35: /datasets/{id}/records - GET records in dataset
36: pagination same as /datasets list
37: params: sort (field name), order (asc|desc), filter (JSON encoded query)
38: 
39: /datasets/{id}/records - POST add record(s)
40: body can be single object or array for bulk insert
41: max 1000 records per request
42: 
43: /datasets/{id}/records/{record_id} - PATCH update single record
44: body: partial record object
45: 
46: /datasets/{id}/sync - POST trigger sync with external source
47: body: { source_id: string, mode: "full"|"incremental" }
48: returns job_id for async tracking
49: 
50: /jobs/{job_id} - GET check job status
51: response: { status: "pending"|"running"|"completed"|"failed", progress: 0-100, error: string|null }
52: 
53: == ERROR CODES ==
54: 
55: 400 - bad request (validation failed) - body has "errors" array with field-specific messages
56: 401 - not authenticated
57: 403 - forbidden (authenticated but not authorized)
58: 404 - not found
59: 409 - conflict (e.g., duplicate name)
60: 422 - unprocessable entity (business rule violation)
61: 429 - rate limited (100 req/min for free tier, 1000 for pro)
62: 500 - server error (we log these, include request_id in response for support)
63: 
64: == RESPONSE FORMAT ==
65: 
66: All responses wrapped:
67: {
68:   "success": true|false,
69:   "data": <payload>|null,
70:   "error": null|{ "code": "ERR_CODE", "message": "Human readable", "details": {} },
71:   "meta": { "request_id": "uuid", "timestamp": "ISO8601" }
72: }
73: 
74: == WEBHOOKS (v2.2 feature) ==
75: 
76: POST /webhooks - create webhook
77: body: { url: string, events: ["dataset.created", "dataset.updated", "sync.completed", "sync.failed"], secret: string (optional, for HMAC signing) }
78: 
79: GET /webhooks - list webhooks
80: DELETE /webhooks/{id} - remove webhook
81: 
82: Webhook payload:
83: {
84:   "event": "event.type",
85:   "timestamp": "ISO8601",
86:   "data": { <event specific> }
87: }
88: 
89: If secret provided, we send X-Webhook-Signature header with HMAC-SHA256 of body
90: 
91: == RATE LIMITS ==
92: 
93: Free tier: 100 requests/minute, 10000/day
94: Pro tier: 1000 requests/minute, unlimited daily
95: Enterprise: custom
96: 
97: Headers returned:
98: X-RateLimit-Limit: <max>
99: X-RateLimit-Remaining: <remaining>
100: X-RateLimit-Reset: <unix timestamp>
101: 
102: == SDK notes ==
103: 
104: Python SDK wraps all this, handles auth refresh automatically
105: JS SDK in beta - dont document yet
106: Java SDK abandoned - dont mention
107: 
108: == CHANGELOG snippets ==
109: 
110: v2.2.0 (2024-12-15)
111: - Added webhooks
112: - Fixed: sync jobs sometimes stuck in "running"
113: - Improved: bulk insert now 3x faster
114: 
115: v2.1.0 (2024-11-01)
116: - BREAKING: Switched to JWT auth (API keys deprecated, removed in v3)
117: - Added incremental sync mode
118: - Fixed: rate limit headers missing on 429 responses
119: 
120: v2.0.0 (2024-09-15)
121: - Complete rewrite
122: - New endpoint structure
123: - Added job queue for async operations
124: 
125: == MISC ==
126: 
127: Base URL: https://api.datasync.io/v2
128: Sandbox: https://sandbox.api.datasync.io/v2 (resets daily, fake data ok)
129: 
130: Content-Type must be application/json for all POST/PUT/PATCH
131: 
132: CORS enabled for *.datasync.io domains, customers can request whitelist
133: 
134: OpenAPI spec is auto-generated but has bugs - dont use directly, needs manual cleanup

(End of file - total 134 lines)
</content>", "type": "text"}]

1: # Developer Notes - DataSync API
2: # These are internal notes from the dev team - NOT for external publication
3: # Last updated by multiple contributors
4: 
5: == AUTH STUFF ==
6: We use JWT tokens now. Changed from API keys last sprint (v2.1).
7: Token expires in 1 hour. Refresh tokens last 7 days.
8: Header format: Authorization: Bearer <token>
9: Login endpoint: POST /auth/login - takes email+password, returns tokens
10: Refresh: POST /auth/refresh - takes refresh_token in body
11: 
12: BUG: Sometimes 401 returns instead of 403 when token valid but perms wrong
13: TODO: Fix in next sprint (JIRA-4521)
14: 
15: == DATA ENDPOINTS ==
16: 
17: /datasets - GET list all datasets for user
18: params: page (default 1), limit (default 20, max 100), status (active|archived|all)
19: returns array of dataset objects
20: 
21: /datasets/{id} - GET single dataset
22: 404 if not found or not owned by user
23: 
24: /datasets - POST create new dataset
25: body: { name: string (required, 3-100 chars), description: string (optional), tags: array }
26: returns created dataset with id
27: 
28: /datasets/{id} - PUT update dataset
29: same body as POST but all fields optional
30: returns updated dataset
31: 
32: /datasets/{id} - DELETE soft delete (sets archived flag)
33: returns 204 no content
34: 
35: /datasets/{id}/records - GET records in dataset
36: pagination same as /datasets list
37: params: sort (field name), order (asc|desc), filter (JSON encoded query)
38: 
39: /datasets/{id}/records - POST add record(s)
40: body can be single object or array for bulk insert
41: max 1000 records per request
42: 
43: /datasets/{id}/records/{record_id} - PATCH update single record
44: body: partial record object
45: 
46: /datasets/{id}/sync - POST trigger sync with external source
47: body: { source_id: string, mode: "full"|"incremental" }
48: returns job_id for async tracking
49: 
50: /jobs/{job_id} - GET check job status
51: response: { status: "pending"|"running"|"completed"|"failed", progress: 0-100, error: string|null }
52: 
53: == ERROR CODES ==
54: 
55: 400 - bad request (validation failed) - body has "errors" array with field-specific messages
56: 401 - not authenticated
57: 403 - forbidden (authenticated but not authorized)
58: 404 - not found
59: 409 - conflict (e.g., duplicate name)
60: 422 - unprocessable entity (business rule violation)
61: 429 - rate limited (100 req/min for free tier, 1000 for pro)
62: 500 - server error (we log these, include request_id in response for support)
63: 
64: == RESPONSE FORMAT ==
65: 
66: All responses wrapped:
67: {
68:   "success": true|false,
69:   "data": <payload>|null,
70:   "error": null|{ "code": "ERR_CODE", "message": "Human readable", "details": {} },
71:   "meta": { "request_id": "uuid", "timestamp": "ISO8601" }
72: }
73: 
74: == WEBHOOKS (v2.2 feature) ==
75: 
76: POST /webhooks - create webhook
77: body: { url: string, events: ["dataset.created", "dataset.updated", "sync.completed", "sync.failed"], secret: string (optional, for HMAC signing) }
78: 
79: GET /webhooks - list webhooks
80: DELETE /webhooks/{id} - remove webhook
81: 
82: Webhook payload:
83: {
84:   "event": "event.type",
85:   "timestamp": "ISO8601",
86:   "data": { <event specific> }
87: }
88: 
89: If secret provided, we send X-Webhook-Signature header with HMAC-SHA256 of body
90: 
91: == RATE LIMITS ==
92: 
93: Free tier: 100 requests/minute, 10000/day
94: Pro tier: 1000 requests/minute, unlimited daily
95: Enterprise: custom
96: 
97: Headers returned:
98: X-RateLimit-Limit: <max>
99: X-RateLimit-Remaining: <remaining>
100: X-RateLimit-Reset: <unix timestamp>
101: 
102: == SDK notes ==
103: 
104: Python SDK wraps all this, handles auth refresh automatically
105: JS SDK in beta - dont document yet
106: Java SDK abandoned - dont mention
107: 
108: == CHANGELOG snippets ==
109: 
110: v2.2.0 (2024-12-15)
111: - Added webhooks
112: - Fixed: sync jobs sometimes stuck in "running"
113: - Improved: bulk insert now 3x faster
114: 
115: v2.1.0 (2024-11-01)
116: - BREAKING: Switched to JWT auth (API keys deprecated, removed in v3)
117: - Added incremental sync mode
118: - Fixed: rate limit headers missing on 429 responses
119: 
120: v2.0.0 (2024-09-15)
121: - Complete rewrite
122: - New endpoint structure
123: - Added job queue for async operations
124: 
125: == MISC ==
126: 
127: Base URL: https://api.datasync.io/v2
128: Sandbox: https://sandbox.api.datasync.io/v2 (resets daily, fake data ok)
129: 
130: Content-Type must be application/json for all POST/PUT/PATCH
131: 
132: CORS enabled for *.datasync.io domains, customers can request whitelist
133: 
134: OpenAPI spec is auto-generated but has bugs - dont use directly, needs manual cleanup

1: # Developer Notes - DataSync API
2: # These are internal notes from the dev team - NOT for external publication
3: # Last updated by multiple contributors
4: 
5: == AUTH STUFF ==
6: We use JWT tokens now. Changed from API keys last sprint (v2.1).
7: Token expires in 1 hour. Refresh tokens last 7 days.
8: Header format: Authorization: Bearer <token>
9: Login endpoint: POST /auth/login - takes email+password, returns tokens
10: Refresh: POST /auth/refresh - takes refresh_token in body
11: 
12: BUG: Sometimes 401 returns instead of 403 when token valid but perms wrong
13: TODO: Fix in next sprint (JIRA-4521)
14: 
15: == DATA ENDPOINTS ==
16: 
17: /datasets - GET list all datasets for user
18: params: page (default 1), limit (default 20, max 100), status (active|archived|all)
19: returns array of dataset objects
20: 
21: /datasets/{id} - GET single dataset
22: 404 if not found or not owned by user
23: 
24: /datasets - POST create new dataset
25: body: { name: string (required, 3-100 chars), description: string (optional), tags: array }
26: returns created dataset with id
27: 
28: /datasets/{id} - PUT update dataset
29: same body as POST but all fields optional
30: returns updated dataset
31: 
32: /datasets/{id} - DELETE soft delete (sets archived flag)
33: returns 204 no content
34: 
35: /datasets/{id}/records - GET records in dataset
36: pagination same as /datasets list
37: params: sort (field name), order (asc|desc), filter (JSON encoded query)
38: 
39: /datasets/{id}/records - POST add record(s)
40: body can be single object or array for bulk insert
41: max 1000 records per request
42: 
43: /datasets/{id}/records/{record_id} - PATCH update single record
44: body: partial record object
45: 
46: /datasets/{id}/sync - POST trigger sync with external source
47: body: { source_id: string, mode: "full"|"incremental" }
48: returns job_id for async tracking
49: 
50: /jobs/{job_id} - GET check job status
51: response: { status: "pending"|"running"|"completed"|"failed", progress: 0-100, error: string|null }
52: 
53: == ERROR CODES ==
54: 
55: 400 - bad request (validation failed) - body has "errors" array with field-specific messages
56: 401 - not authenticated
57: 403 - forbidden (authenticated but not authorized)
58: 404 - not found
59: 409 - conflict (e.g., duplicate name)
60: 422 - unprocessable entity (business rule violation)
61: 429 - rate limited (100 req/min for free tier, 1000 for pro)
62: 500 - server error (we log these, include request_id in response for support)
63: 
64: == RESPONSE FORMAT ==
65: 
66: All responses wrapped:
67: {
68:   "success": true|false,
69:   "data": <payload>|null,
70:   "error": null|{ "code": "ERR_CODE", "message": "Human readable", "details": {} },
71:   "meta": { "request_id": "uuid", "timestamp": "ISO8601" }
72: }
73: 
74: == WEBHOOKS (v2.2 feature) ==
75: 
76: POST /webhooks - create webhook
77: body: { url: string, events: ["dataset.created", "dataset.updated", "sync.completed", "sync.failed"], secret: string (optional, for HMAC signing) }
78: 
79: GET /webhooks - list webhooks
80: DELETE /webhooks/{id} - remove webhook
81: 
82: Webhook payload:
83: {
84:   "event": "event.type",
85:   "timestamp": "ISO8601",
86:   "data": { <event specific> }
87: }
88: 
89: If secret provided, we send X-Webhook-Signature header with HMAC-SHA256 of body
90: 
91: == RATE LIMITS ==
92: 
93: Free tier: 100 requests/minute, 10000/day
94: Pro tier: 1000 requests/minute, unlimited daily
95: Enterprise: custom
96: 
97: Headers returned:
98: X-RateLimit-Limit: <max>
99: X-RateLimit-Remaining: <remaining>
100: X-RateLimit-Reset: <unix timestamp>
101: 
102: == SDK notes ==
103: 
104: Python SDK wraps all this, handles auth refresh automatically
105: JS SDK in beta - dont document yet
106: Java SDK abandoned - dont mention
107: 
108: == CHANGELOG snippets ==
109: 
110: v2.2.0 (2024-12-15)
111: - Added webhooks
112: - Fixed: sync jobs sometimes stuck in "running"
113: - Improved: bulk insert now 3x faster
114: 
115: v2.1.0 (2024-11-01)
116: - BREAKING: Switched to JWT auth (API keys deprecated, removed in v3)
117: - Added incremental sync mode
118: - Fixed: rate limit headers missing on 429 responses
119: 
120: v2.0.0 (2024-09-15)
121: - Complete rewrite
122: - New endpoint structure
123: - Added job queue for async operations
124: 
125: == MISC ==
126: 
127: Base URL: https://api.datasync.io/v2
128: Sandbox: https://sandbox.api.datasync.io/v2 (resets daily, fake data ok)
129: 
130: Content-Type must be application/json for all POST/PUT/PATCH
131: 
132: CORS enabled for *.datasync.io domains, customers can request whitelist
133: 
134: OpenAPI spec is auto-generated but has bugs - dont use directly, needs manual cleanup

(End of file - total 134 lines)
</content>
